description: Find the equivalents of a power cable in other countries' standards ("the Dutch equivalent of this Swedish cable"): the decoded cable is rebuilt under each target rule set (IEC 60502, HD 603, HD 620 sections J/M/D/C/K, BS 5467/6724/7846/6622, EN 50618, HD 627) with the same conductor, section, cores, voltage, screen, armour and sheath, then compared layer by layer with the source of every value. Verdict per standard: equivalent, close (with the differences) or none (with the reason), and the name in that country's letters where sourced. Deterministic, no LLM. Never a statement of interchangeability: the buyer's specification decides.

code.description: A power cable designation with its size and voltage, e.g. "AXCLJ-TT 3x95/25 12/20 kV", "NA2XS(F)2Y 1x240/25 12/20 kV", "YMeKrvaslqwd 12/20 kV 3x95 Al rm +as70", "NYY-J 4x16".

country.description: Comma separated target countries: NL, SE, DK, NO, DE, GB, INT, EU. Default: all.

standard.description: Comma separated target standards: HD620-10J, HD620-10M, HD620-10D, HD620-10K, HD620-10C, HD603-3G, HD603-5G, BS5467, BS6724, BS7846, BS6622, IEC, EN50618, IEC62930, HD627-4N, HD627-7N, IEC60840. Default: all.

name: find_equivalents
title: Find a cable's equivalents in other countries
